name: kunlun-alpha
description: 昆仑智策 - A-Share Intelligence & Quant Platform

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm python:lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm python:typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.python:lint: uv --no-cache run ruff check --no-cache python/ services/
scripts.python:format: uv --no-cache run ruff format --no-cache python/ services/
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d --build
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env down
scripts.v1:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d --build web
scripts.v1:sync: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env --profile real-market-data run --rm --build market-data-sync
scripts.v1:ps: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env --profile real-market-data ps -a
scripts.v1:stop: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env --profile real-market-data stop watchlist-market-data-sync market-data-sync web server postgres clickhouse
scripts.v1:auto:start: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1-auto.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env --profile real-market-data up -d --build market-data-sync
scripts.v1:auto:stop: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1-auto.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env --profile real-market-data stop market-data-sync
scripts.v1:auto:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1-auto.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env --profile real-market-data logs --tail=50 market-data-sync
